metadata.title: Fill or Show: Cue Rules and a Previous-Word Table for Arabic Case Vowels on the Prague Arabic Dependency Treebank (code and results)
metadata.description: Scripts, preregistered protocol, result files and run logs for the study "Fill or Show: Cue Rules and a Previous-Word Table for Arabic Case Vowels on the Prague Arabic Dependency Treebank". The package contains the cue-rule implementation, the previous-word table and threshold selection on the development split, the statistics scripts, the list of 85 indeclinable forms, the treebank checksum and script hashes.
